part.text:
I've called rest, but I'm not certain the robot is right in front of the green panel.

The robot reached the end of the corridor and turned left into the side section, where the green panel is. The last few forward walks stopped early because of collision protection, which I took to mean the panel was close. However, the side sonars read 2.55 m (their maximum), so I have no measurement of the distance to the panel. The camera shows it still some distance ahead, and the robot is now crouched and resting at about x=4.41 m, y=1.24 m in its odometry.

If you need it exactly in front of the panel, I can stand the robot up and make a few short, careful steps forward.
